builds.name: Double Up: kill-triggered critical bounce
builds.summary: Investigate high Double Up critical second shot output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Double Up critical second shot output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q base is 120 + total AD + 0.35 AP physical. Its critical-bounce helper uses the bespoke factor 1 + 0.5 times (critical damage minus 1), rather than an ordinary attack crit multiplier. Killing the first target guarantees the second shot crits. Infinity Edge changes the explicit factor; flat AD and physical penetration compete with unnecessary extra crit chance once the kill is guaranteed.
